data_point: E-commerce or retail business holding physical inventory
run_when: Code found a store platform, 'add to cart', stock labels or shipping pages.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company's operations depend on holding and tracking physical inventory (stock levels, cost of goods, purchase orders, warehousing, fulfilment).
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Never exclude on an inference, an estimate or missing information. Scope this narrowly.
yes_when: A storefront selling physical goods with stock or 'sold out' indicators
Shipping and returns policies for physical items
Jobs in supply chain, inventory or fulfilment
no_when: Digital goods, subscriptions, memberships, software, services booked online, print-on-demand, or dropshipping where the company never holds stock
unknown_when: It sells physical goods but there's no sign whether it holds the stock itself
watch_out_for: Print-on-demand (Printful, Printify) and dropshipping are NOT excluded
If you can't tell whether they hold inventory, answer unknown

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.

examples.input_excerpt: Shop Men's Shoes. Tree Runner $98. Sold out in size 10. Free shipping and 30-day returns.

output.evidence_quote: Sold out in size 10. Free shipping and 30-day returns.
output.reason: A store selling physical shoes with stock levels and shipping.
